extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: Christmas, a new seasonal theme. Cream on deep evergreen with a holly red accent and gold highlights, snow drifting down and frost in the corners. With no background picture of your own, a snowy village at night: a tree with twinkling lights and a star, a church, a robin on the fence, and a couple of things for those who look closely. With a picture, a soft night wash over it with the snow and frost on top. Santa's sleigh crosses the moon now and then. Christmas Eve, the night of 24 December: the village is always up and the sleigh comes round far more often. At midnight it lands on a rooftop and stays parked there all Christmas Day. Both come on by themselves from the first Saturday of December to the end of Boxing Day. The new setting Christmas every year switches that off without touching Halloween, and the Theme row picks either one by hand at any time.
